datasheet_identity.title: FDN5618P 60V P-Channel Power MOSFET

extraction_notes: FDN5618P is explicitly identified as a 60 V P-Channel Power MOSFET. P-channel signs are retained in conditions and represented as positive magnitudes in numeric fit fields.
The electrical characteristics table gives VGS(th) min -1.4 V, typ -2.0 V, max -2.6 V at VDS = VGS and ID = -250 uA; all min/typ/max meanings are preserved as magnitudes.
RDS(ON) is published at two gate drives: typ 150 mOhm, max 200 mOhm at VGS = -10 V and ID = -1.5 A; typ 190 mOhm, max 240 mOhm at VGS = -4.5 V and ID = -1.5 A. All four values are retained.

The p. 3 output, transfer, RDS(on), and body-diode curves and p. 4 capacitance curves were manually digitized from the published typical figures. Points are curve readings, not interpolated vendor or SPICE data.

The electrical table publishes typical trr = 25 ns at TJ = 25 degC and IF = -1.5 A with di/dt = -100 A/us, and Qrr = 31 nC under the same switching condition; these fields are not represented by the strict schema.
RthetaJA is 83.3 degC/W maximum, and the absolute limits are VDS -60 V, VGS +/-20 V, continuous ID -1.6 A, pulsed IDM -8 A, and PD 1.5 W at TC = 25 degC unless otherwise noted.
omission_reason: Gate charge, switching times, reverse-recovery time/charge, thermal resistance, off-state leakage, transconductance, and power/current ratings are present in the PDF but have no fields in the strict extraction schema.
